subject: Error in SparkR installation from Github

messages.author: 81349c82fb5ee906
messages.subject: Error in SparkR installation from Github
parts:
I am trying to install SparkR in my local machine using the following command, in RStudio

> library(devtools)
> install_github("amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg", subdir="pkg")

After running above written command, it starts downloading Rtools and installation happens. And then got the following error



Error: Could not find build tools necessary to build SparkR

I have run the above command again, but same error occur.
Please help me out.

messages.author: f4108b5f63668d70
messages.subject: Re: Error in SparkR installation from Github
parts:
SparkR is now a part of Apache Spark. You can download it from
http://spark.apache.org/downloads.html (any version > 1.4.0)

Thanks
Shivaram
